name: _readme
about: Golden set for the coaching eval harness. Replace the example below with real cases from your store. Find session_id + lap numbers via GET /api/v1/sessions and /sessions/{id}/laps (or scripts/import_latest.ps1 then the API). Entries whose name starts with '_' are ignored.
expectation_note: The harness scores factuality deterministically against the findings; you don't need to hand-label correct answers. Add an 'expect_top_corner' field only if you want a stricter outcome assertion.
